category_title: Preschoolers at risk for developmental delays with mild to moderate language disorders
scenario_title: Developing a play plan during the advanced play organizer
minimal_context: The student and a peer are in the classroom with kitchen toys, tasked with developing a play plan for the session.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to make a play plan for the kitchen toys. What do you want to do with them?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands away from the peer and looks at the floor, appearing lonely and anxious instead of initiating a conversation.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Talk to your friend and decide what to play.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Remains completely silent, making no comments to the peer about the toys.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Come on, you need to make a plan together. Tell each other what to do.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Shows increased anxiety during the awkward silence and begins to have a temper tantrum, throwing a plastic plate and refusing to follow directions.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to make a play plan for the kitchen toys. What do you want to do with them?

STUDENT: (Stands away from the peer and looks at the floor, appearing lonely and anxious instead of initiating a conversation.)

TUTOR: Talk to your friend and decide what to play.

STUDENT: (Remains completely silent, making no comments to the peer about the toys.)

TUTOR: Come on, you need to make a plan together. Tell each other what to do.

STUDENT: (Shows increased anxiety during the awkward silence and begins to have a temper tantrum, throwing a plastic plate and refusing to follow directions.)

task.content: developed a play plan specific to the play theme designated for the session
task.learning_goal: instruction of the use of specific social behaviors

context.materials: dramatic play toys (kitchen, hospital) or manipulative toys (cars, blocks)

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: if the children could not make a play plan independently
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: demonstrated fewer social skills (e.g., making friends, following directions, initiating conversations with peers) and decreased the frequency of comments to fewer than five comments in a session or no comments
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: appears lonely, shows anxiety, is sad or depressed
